gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Snowburst One brings its stenciled, bold lowercase up top. Noto Sans Tai Le settles underneath with ink strokes tapering out before they touch and almost no step from capitals to lowercase, so extended text glides along smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-th: Chalk-board lowercase crowds toward the capital line here, with the inside of each c clearly visible. Snowburst One adds a stenciled, bold heading above it, and the sans text below gives that loud top a plainly legible partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-vi: Noto Sans Tai Viet has short ascenders and a tall x-height, with terminals pulled back from where curves close. But Snowburst One, a stenciled display face, is the loud one, so a sans-serif paragraph beneath it moves along comfortably.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri is a plain sans with a generously unclosed curve on every small round letter and a high-waisted lowercase. gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil: A stencil sheet with wide bridges between its letters defines Snowburst One, and its lowercase stands tall. Noto Sans Tamil is the sans that does the text work, looking magnified at any size, while Snowburst One does the shouting.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads as a sans with round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Snowburst One's stenciled boldness is the standout.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Stencil bold, tall, and unmistakable. Noto Sans Tangsa follows as a plain sans with wide, inviting openings on round letters and short ascender stems, so paragraphs of it feel approachable and unhurried.
